messages:
alex.m: Heads up — we've got 6 DOA units from the EU cluster. Vendor says they'll do RMAs but customs is flagging missing commercial invoice. tracking AWB 123-4567890.

maria_ops: ugh. which vendor? need to know if they can reissue a consolidated invoice for the batch to avoid 6 separate customs entries.

amy_nexasupply: Hi team, Amy here from NEXA Supply. We can consolidate RMAs into a single AWB if you authorize consolidation. We'll need serials + order refs and approval to reissue one commercial invoice. Consolidation saves ~$1.2k in customs fees.

kevin_supply: sending serials now — see CSV snippet: 
```
SN,ORDER
GPU-A1,ORD-3321
GPU-B2,ORD-3321
GPU-C3,ORD-3322
GPU-D4,ORD-3322
GPU-E5,ORD-3323
GPU-F6,ORD-3323
```

alex.m: @amy_nexasupply can you confirm that consolidated AWB won't delay processing vs separate shipments? customs often holds consolidated shipments for extra inspection.

amy_nexasupply: Good question. We ran this with DHL before — consolidated AWB added 2-12hr hold risk but overall fewer per-unit fees. If you need fastest replacement, we can do split AWBs and overnight, but cost ~3x. Tradeoff? :thinking_face: 

maria_ops: cost and time numbers pls. Also, any chance to do local swap vs international RMA? Our EU repair partner might have spare inventory.

amy_nexasupply: Quick figures: consolidated freight ~€950, estimated customs fees €420 total, ETA to clear 48-72h; split overnight ~€2,800, customs per AWB ~€90 each but processed faster 24-36h. Local swap depends on allocation — I can check if there's 2x units in FRA DC.

dhl_bot: AWB 123-4567890 status: held at FRA customs — reason: missing commercial invoice. Link: https://dhl.example/track/1234567890

kevin_supply: ok approve consolidation if net cost < split. Maria — if we consolidate, Ops to prepare one PO amendment with combined values and original order refs.

maria_ops: will draft PO amendment and send to @amy_nexasupply by EOD. Also confirm whether replacement parts nee serial mapping for restocking credits.

amy_nexasupply: Affirmative — we need SN mapping to issue credit memos. Once consolidated invoice signed, we'll provide reissued doc within 4 hours and request DHL release.

alex.m: Thanks. final ask — if customs still rejects, do we have fallback to credit + local procurement? Kevin, estimate procurement ETA for 2x replacement from EU market.

kevin_supply: quick market check: 2x cards same spec can be sourced in 3-5 business days at ~€5.8k each. If we go local, no customs, but rebuild config and image time ~6hrs each.

maria_ops: decision: consolidate AWB. Action owner list: amy_nexasupply -> reissue invoice; maria_ops -> PO amend; kevin_supply -> standby for local buy if release >72h; alex.m -> update cluster routing to avoid failed nodes. :white_check_mark: 

amy_nexasupply: Received. I'll push invoice in 3h and ping DHL clearance team immediately.

alex.m: appreciated. keep thread updates short — just status pings.

kevin_supply: noted.

maria_ops: updated PO sent (attached). Please confirm receipt. Thanks!

amy_nexasupply: Received PO amendment. Invoice reissued and sent to DHL ops. AWB update: release requested. I'll post DHL tracking when cleared.

dhl_bot: AWB 123-4567890 status: release requested by shipper. Customs hold cleared at 2025-12-04T09:45Z. ETA to warehouse 12h.

alex.m: excellent. once on-site, we'll do serial verification and RMA closeout. Closing thread after final confirmation.

maria_ops: final — goods received by FRA warehouse, serials matched, NEXA issued credit memos for 6 units. RMA closed. thanks all. :tada:
